title: Choosing Yes shows only work orders whose asset is on site
permissions_required: Any signed-in user with access to the Work Orders page (the spec defines no role-based differences - OQ-4).
preconditions: 1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. You are on the Work Orders page on the All tab.
3. Work orders exist in both states: some with the asset marked on site and some not (set the on-site marker on ZZAUTOTEST work orders as needed).
steps: 1. Open the Asset on site filter and choose Yes.
2. Look at the On Site column in the table (green house icon = on site, red = not).
expected: 1. The table shows only work orders whose asset is currently on site.
2. Work orders whose asset is not on site are hidden.
3. Choosing No instead shows only the not-on-site work orders.
design_ref: design-notes.md B.1 #12 (11880:12460); B.1 shared shell (On Site column icons)
notes: Which field in the build drives a work order's on-site status is open (OQ-6) - the mobile design shows an 'Asset On Site' toggle on the work order card; VIU-confirm the data source and seed both states before testing.
